title: Pinecone Herald in the Marsh
description: A surreal scene set in a marshy pond with lily pads. A faceless black armored figure stands waist-deep in water, one hand raised, water splashing around it. Above floats a large heraldic shield displaying three black pinecones, topped by a knight's helmet with a cross and surrounded by ornate silver scrollwork and reeds. A banner below reads 'Forest Spirit'.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene in a calm marsh pond filled with yellow-green lily pads and tall reeds under a blue sky. A glossy black faceless armored figure stands waist-deep in reflective water with one hand raised, water splashing. Floating above is a large white heraldic shield with three detailed black pinecones arranged in a triangle, topped with an ornate silver knight helmet with a cross and green foliage. Silver scrollwork frames the shield. A silver banner beneath reads 'Forest Spirit' in gothic script. Detailed digital painting with realistic water reflections.
